tables.name: Tavern Names
tables.description: 100 random tavern and inn names with a brief vibe.
entries: The Drunken Dragon — rowdy adventurer bar, sawdust on the floor
The Silver Swan — upscale, white tablecloths, harp player
The Rusty Hook — dockside dive, smells like fish and tar
The Gilded Griffin — wealthy merchant hangout, velvet curtains
The Crooked Crown — former noble's house, now a pub
The Black Bear — lumberjack bar, huge fireplace, axes on walls
The Howling Wolf — northern outpost, fur blankets, mead only
The Golden Goose — gambling den upstairs, quiet bar below
The Wandering Minstrel — live music every night, open mic
The Iron Keg — dwarven run establishment, stone interior, strong ale
The Moonlit Garden — elven tea house by day, wine bar by night
The Greasy Spoon — cheap food, rough crowd, fights nightly
The Blue Parrot — tropical theme, exotic drinks, pirate clientele
The Crimson Cat — upscale bordello bar, velvet and candlelight
The Whispering Willow — quiet, bookish, poets and scholars
The Thunder Hammer — forge-themed, run by a retired smith
The Salty Mermaid — coastal bar, seafood, nautical decor
The Broken Arrow — archer's guild bar, target practice in back
The Laughing Lich — necromancer-themed novelty bar, surprisingly fun
The Silent Knife — thieves' guild front, nobody asks questions
The Dancing Bear — has a real bear (it's a druid, don't tell)
The Copper Coin — cheap, basic, everyone's been there once
The Firefly — romantic, candlelit, very popular with couples
The Iron Horse — carriage house turned bar, stables out back
The Ruby Slipper — fancy, exclusive, bouncer at the door
The Frosted Mug — serves everything cold, ice sculptures in winter
The Rotten Apple — bad part of town, you know what you're getting into
The Singing Sword — bard college bar, impromptu performances
The Stone Troll — built inside a cave, very atmospheric
The Lucky Clover — Irish-themed, green everything, live fiddle
The Ghost Ship — haunted shipwreck theme, actual ghost sometimes
The Velvet Glove — fancy fighting club bar, gladiators drinking post-match
The Squealing Pig — farm-to-table, rustic, the owner's pig is the mascot
The Burning Tower — wizard's tower theme, cocktails with flair
The Hollow Oak — built around a giant tree, elven architecture
The Dripping Dagger — assassin bar, everybody sits with their back to the wall
The Golden Harvest — autumn theme, cider, pumpkin everything
The Brass Monkey — sailors bar, tropical, very loud
The Sleeping Giant — mountain basecamp, serves huge portions
The Crimson Coin — blood money bar, mercenaries and bounty hunters
The Crystal Ball — divination-themed, seers and fortune tellers
The Wooden Nickel — cheap, but the food is surprisingly good
The Iron Maiden — torture-themed goth bar, run by a very nice lady
The Flaming Phoenix — constantly burning down and being rebuilt
The Shadow Rose — dark elf bar, dim lighting, mysterious patrons
The Drunken Monk — former monastery, serves only fermented fruit
The Silver Hammer — smiths' guild bar, very sturdy furniture
The Lost Highway — roadside inn, nobody knows the owner's real name
The Wicked Wench — pirate bar, peg leg bartender, parrot mascot
The Hollow Crown — deposed nobles drinking their fortunes away
The Wild Hunt — fey-themed bar, changes location sometimes
The Broken Wheel — roadside repair shop and bar, weird combo but it works
The Golden Lion — noble's favorite, very expensive, doorman judges you
The Rusty Nail — construction worker bar, cheap beer, loud arguments
The Moonstone — elven bar, serves glowing drinks, very chill
The Hanged Man — gallows humor, gallows out front, dark jokes
The Smoking Gun — artificer bar, weird inventions on display
The Frost Giant — everything is huge, giant mugs, giant portions
The Silver Serpent — poisoner's bar, every drink has an antidote chaser
The Thirsty Camel — desert oasis bar, serves date wine and water (expensive)
The Black Cat — witch-themed, potions as cocktails, cauldron centerpiece
The Wagon Wheel — frontier bar, swinging doors, piano player
The Cursed Crown — legend says whoever wears it dies... of alcohol poisoning
The Dancing Flame — fire dancer bar, very popular, very dangerous
The Sunken Ship — underwater bar (it's just a sunken ship, you swim in)
The Iron Fist — monk bar, they only drink water, it's very disappointing
The Golden Goose egg — overpriced breakfast place, bottomless mimosas
The Raging Bull — minotaur bar, everything is reinforced, lots of meat
The Spider's Web — drow bar, silk curtains, lots of nooks and crannies
The Crooked Dice — gambling hall, loaded dice (don't tell anyone)
The Burning Candle — library bar, very quiet, you get shushed if you're loud
The Storm Crow — sailors' weather bar, predictions are usually wrong
The Jade Tiger — eastern theme, tea ceremonies by day, opium den by night
The Sour Grapes — wine bar, snooty owner, judges your taste
The Clockwork Dragon — artificer steampunk bar, moving parts everywhere
The Merry Mermaid — brothel bar, the drinks are not the main attraction
The Grave Digger — cemetery adjacent bar, very morbid regulars
The Flying Dutchman — ghost ship bar, you pay with memories
The Brass Knuckles — fight club bar, basement ring, bet on the matches
The White Rabbit — fey bar, time moves weird inside
The Blacksmith's Daughter — the owner is a blacksmith's daughter, she's huge
The Sapphire Sea — underwater themed, blue everything, fish tanks
The Howling Banshee — haunted bar, the screams add atmosphere
The Golden Harp — bard bar, open mic night, some are actually good
The Rotten Tooth — orc bar, the food is disgusting but the ale is strong
The Crystal Caves — geode bar, lit by glowing crystals, very pretty
The Wandering Eye — traveler's inn, exotic food, stories from afar
The Ironclad — heavily fortified bar, survived 3 sieges
The Drunken Sailor — sea shanty bar, everybody sings, nobody knows the words
The Mad Hatter — tea and alchemy bar, weird concoctions, fun hats
The Shadow Thief — rogue bar, everything is pickpocket-proof, nothing is
The Sunflower — halfling bar, cozy, lots of pies, second breakfast
The Thorned Rose — dark fey bar, beautiful but dangerous
The Windmill — built in an old windmill, great view, creaky floors
The Blood Moon — werewolf bar, full moon nights get wild
The Stone Fountain — courtyard bar, central fountain, outdoor seating
The Lonely Lighthouse — cliffside bar, ocean view, one regular who never leaves
The Whispering Skull — necromancer bar, the skulls on the wall whisper
The Fire Breathing Dragon — spicy food challenge bar, sign a waiver first
The Royal Flush — noble's gambling den, very exclusive, very expensive
Last Stop — the bar at the end of the world, literally on the edge of a cliff

tables.name: NPC Hooks
tables.description: 100 hooks to make random NPCs interesting.
entries: Is secretly a dragon in human form, hates conflict
Owes a debt to a crime lord and can't pay
Is looking for their lost sibling who went adventuring
Used to be a famous adventurer, now retired with a limp
Is a spy for a neighboring kingdom
Has a magic item they don't know is magical
Is being blackmailed over a past mistake
Is running from an arranged marriage
Owns a map to a hidden treasure but can't go themselves
Is secretly a were-creature trying to live a normal life
Believes they're the chosen one of a prophecy (they're not)
Is cursed to tell only lies, hates it
Is actually a ghost who doesn't know they're dead
Has been replaced by a doppelganger (the real one is in the basement)
Is a retired assassin trying to go straight
Is part of a secret society recruiting new members
Lost their memory and doesn't know who they are
Is being haunted by the ghost of someone they wronged
Has a price on their head, innocent of the crime
Is the bastard child of a noble, hidden from the family
Is a wizard in disguise researching something mundane
Is deathly afraid of something ridiculous (like ducks)
Can talk to animals but nobody believes them
Is searching for a specific rare ingredient for a potion
Has visions of the future that are always slightly wrong
Is a former noble who lost everything in a bet
Is running a scam but feels really bad about it
Is in love with someone completely out of their league
Has a dark secret that only their pet knows
Is a master of disguise, has 5 different identities in the same city
Is being followed (they are, it's just a really bad spy)
Is convinced the world is a simulation
Is writing a book about their life, it's terrible
Is a failed poet who now works a normal job
Hasn't slept in 3 years due to a curse, surprisingly functional
Is actually 3 gnomes in a trench coat
Is hiding from their past in the most obvious way possible
Collects something weird (like fancy spoons)
Is a chef who poisoned a king by accident and is on the run
Is the long-lost heir to a throne they don't want
Speaks to inanimate objects, they sometimes answer
Is being slowly turned to stone, doesn't tell anyone
Is a former gladiator who won their freedom, can't stop fighting
Is terrible at their job but somehow keeps getting promoted
Has a magical tattoo that moves and has opinions
Is actually a construct, thinks they're real
Is running from a cult they used to be in
Can see dead people, it's really awkward at funerals
Is secretly very wealthy but pretends to be poor
Is the reason the local monster problem exists
Is investigating the same thing as the party, but from the wrong angle
Is a kleptomaniac, steals things they don't need
Believes they're cursed with bad luck (they're just clumsy)
Is a former villain who had a change of heart
Is dating a monster, it's complicated
Has an imaginary friend that's actually an invisible imp
Is allergic to magic, sneezes fireballs
Is the seventh son of a seventh son, nothing special about it
Wakes up with no memory every morning, keeps a journal
Is a shapeshifter who can only turn into furniture
Is the real villain's accountant, knows everything
Is training pigeons to deliver messages, it's not going well
Is afraid of the dark, sleeps with 12 candles
Was raised by wolves, still has trouble with doors
Is a bard who only sings about one specific dragon
Invented something that doesn't work but everyone's too nice to say
Is the last of their kind, their kind was really annoying
Made a deal with a devil, got a great interest rate
Is being slowly driven insane by their magic item
Is actually two people sharing one body on alternating days
Is a time traveler from the past, is obsessed with doorknobs
Knows the true name of a demon, uses it to get free stuff
Is a vampire who only drinks animal blood, gets made fun of by other vampires
Is the chosen one of a very minor god of houseplants
Has a shadow that acts independently, mostly it just sasses people
Is actually a really powerful wizard who lost their powers doing laundry
Is convinced they're in a dream, acts accordingly
Is a professional mourner, gets paid to cry at funerals
Is hiding a dragon in their basement (it's small, but growing)
Was cursed by a witch, the curse is just that they always lose their keys
Is actually 200 years old, looks 30, drinks a lot of water
Is deathly allergic to adventure, breaks out in hives near dungeons
Can only speak in riddles, it's not a curse they're just pretentious
Is the mayor, nobody elected them, they just showed up one day
Has a talking parrot that knows all their secrets, it's blackmailing them
Is a former royal guard, was fired for saving the wrong royal
Makes the best pies in town, the secret ingredient is not people (it's cinnamon)
Is being courted by two different suitors, both are monsters
Died once, came back wrong (they can now communicate with houseplants)
Is a professional thief, only steals from other thieves
Is the local librarian, knows literally everything about everyone
Is a failed alchemist, their experiments turned their cat purple
Is training to be a hero, it's not going great
Is actually a god in disguise, testing people's kindness
Has never lost a staring contest, nobody knows why
Is the reason the well is cursed, they dropped something important down there
Is a traveling merchant who only sells items that are slightly cursed
Can predict the weather perfectly, has never been wrong about anything else
Is hiding from the tax collector, has been for 15 years
Is actually very boring, the rumors about them are way more interesting

Grows warm in the presence of lies
Changes color based on the wielder's mood
Makes the wielder's hair grow twice as fast
Whispers terrible jokes at night
Leaves a trail of glitter that only shows up in moonlight
Makes the wielder sneeze when they cast a spell
Is slightly sticky, always
Gravitates toward the nearest cat
Changes size depending on how confident the wielder is
Makes everything taste like cinnamon
Emits a faint smell of wet dog when used
Refuses to work on Tuesdays
The wielder always knows what time it is, in Celestial
Drips water continuously, never runs out
Makes the wielder's voice an octave deeper
Attracts butterflies
Is sentient but very shy, only talks to bards
Makes the wielder really want to clean things
Grows moss when unused for too long
Always points north, even when you're holding it wrong
Makes mirrors show the wielder 10% more attractive
Causes nearby fire to flicker in time with the wielder's heartbeat
The wielder can only speak in rhyme while holding it
Makes plants grow slightly faster nearby
Is heavier than it looks, by exactly 7 pounds
Makes the wielder hiccup bubbles
Always lands on its edge when dropped
Makes doors creak loudly when the wielder enters a room
The wielder dreams of being a bird every night
Attracts lightning during storms (doesn't protect from it)
Makes food last twice as long in the wielder's pack
Is very polite, always says 'thank you' when put away
Makes the wielder's shadow dance when they're happy
Grows warm when the wielder is in love
The wielder always knows direction, but only to the nearest bakery
Makes nearby clocks run backwards
The wielder can't lie while holding it, but can exaggerate a lot
Glows faintly when someone says its name
Makes paper crumple itself in the wielder's presence
The wielder always wakes up exactly at sunrise
Makes all dogs love the wielder, all cats hate them
Is slightly radioactive, not dangerously, just enough to be concerning
Makes the wielder really good at dancing, really bad at walking
Changes its own shape slightly every full moon
The wielder can understand birds, but birds are all jerks
Makes wine taste better and water taste worse
Is obsessed with collecting socks (pairs only)
The wielder gets deja vu constantly
Makes the wielder's handwriting perfect, but only in Elvish
Emits faint organ music during dramatic moments
The wielder always knows when it's about to rain (3 seconds before)
Makes nearby children cry for no reason
The wielder can't lose a coin flip, ever (always lands on edge)
Is mildly telepathic, only broadcasts song lyrics
Makes the wielder's eyes glow faintly in the dark
The wielder always trips over nothing exactly once per day
Makes rope untie itself when nobody's looking
Is very judgmental, sighs loudly when the wielder makes bad decisions
Makes the wielder crave pickles at random intervals
The wielder can speak to doors, most doors are boring
Glows brighter the more people are watching
Makes mirrors fog up permanently after one use
The wielder always lands on their feet, except when they don't
Is allergic to iron, breaks out in rust spots
Makes the wielder really good at card games, really bad at dice
The wielder can breathe underwater... but only for 6 seconds
Makes all nearby doors stick slightly
Is very old, tells stories about the good old days constantly
The wielder's tears become small diamonds (they taste like salt still)
Makes nearby flowers bloom out of season
The wielder always knows if someone is talking about them behind their back
Is slightly evil, but in a petty way (hides keys, unties shoelaces)
Makes the wielder's laugh echo even in small rooms
The wielder can't get drunk, but they get really sleepy instead
Makes all nearby clocks correct to the second
Is attracted to magic items of the opposite type (it's complicated)
The wielder always knows the shortest path, but only through alleys
Makes nearby fires burn with green flames
The wielder can communicate with their own reflection, it's very supportive
Is afraid of heights, gets heavier when carried up stairs
Makes the wielder really good at climbing, really bad at descending
The wielder always leaves perfect footprints, even on stone
Makes nearby undead slightly more polite
Is actually two magic items in a relationship, they bicker constantly
The wielder can see in the dark, but only shades of beige
Makes music sound slightly better, food slightly worse
The wielder always wins arguments with inanimate objects
Is cursed to be found by the exact wrong person every time
Makes the wielder's footsteps completely silent... except on gravel
The wielder can teleport... exactly 1 inch to the left, once per day
Makes all nearby spiders grow an extra leg (they're fine with it)
The wielder can smell lies, but only cheesy ones
Is powered by compliments, works better if you tell it it's pretty
Makes the wielder really good at opening jars
The wielder's shadow has a mind of its own, mostly it just naps
Is one of a set of 7, the other 6 are in a drawer somewhere
Makes the wielder remember every password they've ever had
The wielder can turn invisible... but only their left pinky
Is actually just a normal item that everyone thinks is magic

tables.name: Dungeon Rooms
tables.description: 100 random dungeon room ideas to fill empty spaces on your map.
entries: A circular room with a floor covered in mysterious runes that glow when stepped on
A long hallway lined with statues, each one turns its head to follow you
A room half-filled with water, something moves beneath the surface
A chamber with a bottomless pit in the center, a narrow bridge crosses it
A room where the walls are covered in thousands of eyes, all blinking
A small chamber with a single chest in the middle, it's clearly a mimic
A grand hall with a throne, the skeleton on the throne still wears its crown
A room with a giant hourglass, sand is pouring... upward
A library with bookshelves lining every wall, the books whisper
A torture chamber, all the equipment looks recently used
A room with a fountain, the water is a very suspicious color
A long corridor with portraits on the walls, the people in them move when you're not looking
A circular room with no doors, you entered through the ceiling somehow
A room filled with webs, something big lives in the middle
A chamber with a crystal ball on a pedestal, it shows something you don't want to see
A kitchen, the pots and pans stir themselves
A room with mirrors on every wall, your reflection is slightly too slow
A large cavern with a subterranean lake, there's an island in the middle
A room with a giant skull, the mouth is a doorway
A prison block with dozens of cells, some are occupied
A temple to a forgotten god, the altar still has offerings
A room where gravity is reversed, the 'floor' is the ceiling
A workshop full of clockwork parts, something is being built
A room with a massive chain descending into darkness
A garden of strange fungi, some glow, some scream
A throne room, the throne is empty but clearly meant for someone important
A room with a well, the bucket is already lowered
A bedroom that looks like it was abandoned mid-use, bed still made
A treasury, it's been looted already but you missed one thing
A room with a puzzle door, the solution is written backwards on the ceiling
A long staircase that spirals downward, it never seems to end
A chamber with pillars, each pillar has a different carving
A room that's completely dark, light sources don't work
A kitchen, the smell of fresh bread fills the air, nobody's here
A room with a painting of a landscape, you swear the landscape just moved
A sacrificial chamber, blood stains on the altar are still wet
A room full of treasure... it's all illusions
A forge, the fire is still hot, the blacksmith is gone
A room with a pool of black liquid, it reflects what you could have been
A long bridge over a chasm, it's missing a few planks
A room with hundreds of candles, they all light themselves when you enter
A study, someone was doing research here, the notes are in code
A room with a giant cog mechanism, it's still turning
A chamber with a tree growing through the ceiling, it shouldn't be possible
A room where time moves differently, you age a year in 10 seconds... then you un-age
A banquet hall, a feast is laid out, it's all dust
A room with a magic circle on the floor, something was summoned here
A room full of armor stands, one of them is not a stand
A chapel to a good god, it has been desecrated
A room with a bottomless well, you can hear something breathing far below
A laboratory, glass vials everywhere, some are still bubbling
A room that's perfectly square, perfectly empty, perfectly silent
A coliseum-like chamber, something was fought here, the winner is still around
A room with a wall of faces, they're all screaming silently
A storage room full of crates, mostly junk, one has something good
A room with a telescope aimed at the ceiling, the ceiling shows stars
A bathhouse, the water is still warm
A room with a massive door, it's clearly the way to the boss
A shrine to a trickster god, something about this room feels off
A room with a giant chess board, the pieces are life-sized
A nursery, rusted cribs and broken toys
A room filled with sand, it's pouring in from somewhere
A library with a ladder that rolls on its own
A room with a fountain of youth, it doesn't work anymore (it makes you older now)
A room full of mirrors, each one shows a different version of you
A torture chamber that's also a very nice bakery? The juxtaposition is confusing
A room with a sleeping dragon, you should probably be quiet
A room that's an exact copy of the last room you were in, except one thing is different
A garden, underground, lit by glowing moss, very peaceful
A room with a pit full of bones, the bones are starting to assemble themselves
A bedroom for a giant, everything is huge
A room with a music box, it plays a tune you remember from childhood but can't place
A room with a scale, it wants you to weigh your heart
A long corridor, the walls slowly close in when you're halfway through
A room with a fountain that grants wishes... very literal, very petty wishes
A room full of hats, all of them are cursed, some of the curses are good
A room with a painting of the party, you're all older, some are missing
A tavern, underground, run by a goblin, it's actually pretty good
A room with a floor that's one big trapdoor, it opens when you least expect it
A chamber with a phoenix, it's currently ash, will reborn in 10 seconds
A room full of weapons, they're all nailed to the wall... except one
A room with a well that answers questions, but only in riddles
A throne made of bones, whoever sits on it gains power and loses their mind
A room that's just a massive pile of garbage, there's good stuff in there somewhere
A room with a storm inside, thunder, lightning, rain, all contained by magic
A room with a frozen adventurer in a block of ice, they're still alive
A room with a portal, it goes somewhere, you don't know where
A gambling den, run by a demon, the stakes are souls
A room with a cat, it's been here for 200 years, it's fine
A chamber with an oracle, she'll answer one question, badly
A room full of treasure and one very angry guardian
A room with stairs that go up and down at the same time
A room with a bed, if you sleep in it you have visions of the future
A room with a noose hanging from the ceiling, it swings on its own
A room that's the final boss's bedroom, they're not here right now
A room with a fountain that spews gold coins, and also acid
A library, the books are alive and they don't like being read
A room with a giant lock, the key is somewhere really obvious
A room that's the exit, but something is guarding it

tables.name: Weather Effects
tables.description: 100 weird and magical weather phenomena for your world.
entries: Rain that falls upward from the ground to the clouds
Snow that is warm to the touch, melts at body temperature
Fog that shows you memories of people who walked here before
Wind that whispers secrets, most of them are true
Rain of frogs, they're all wearing tiny crowns
Sunshower while it's raining, a fox wedding is happening somewhere
The sky turns green for an hour, everyone feels slightly nauseous
Stars fall from the sky, they land softly and turn into flowers
Thunder that sounds like laughter, deep and rumbling
Lightning that strikes in the same spot 7 times, something is being summoned
Rain that smells like cinnamon, everyone gets a little hungry
Snow that doesn't melt, even in fire, it's actually ash
Fog that makes everyone's voice sound like someone else's
A rainbow at night, it leads to somewhere you shouldn't go
The moon is twice its normal size, werewolves are having a bad day
The sun is blue, plants grow twice as fast, people are extra happy
It rains coins, copper mostly, a few silver, everyone gets hit in the head
A heat wave in the middle of winter, snow melts in seconds, floods
A cold snap in summer, lakes freeze over in minutes
The clouds form shapes that predict the future, vaguely
It rains teeth, human teeth, nobody knows where they come from
A blood red moon, evil magic is stronger tonight
The sky has no sun, no moon, no stars, just gray, for 3 days
Double rainbow, double the luck (good or bad, flip a coin)
Aurora borealis in the wrong hemisphere, magic goes haywire
It rains cats and dogs, literal ones, they're fine, just confused
Thunder without lightning, something big is walking nearby
Lightning without thunder, silent but very bright
Dust storm that turns everything sepia-toned for a day
Rain that makes you forget things, short-term memory loss for 1 hour
Snow that is actually tiny feathers, from what bird?
The wind carries music, distant, beautiful, nobody can place the tune
A mirage of a city appears on the horizon, it's not there when you arrive
The tide goes out and never comes back, something is wrong with the moon
It rains writing, words in a language nobody knows
A solar eclipse that lasts too long, shadows come alive
A lunar eclipse during the day, it shouldn't be possible
Meteor shower, they're getting closer, you should probably run
